image.subject: 台灣虎航董事長黃世惠
image.sourceCaption: 台灣虎航董事長黃世惠（右）1日與旅遊科技業者Dohop營運總監艾特肯（Hugh Aitken）（左）簽署MOU，宣布打造一站式轉機服務平台。（台灣虎航提供）中央社記者余曉涵傳真　115年10月1日

zh.title: 台灣虎航推出 Tigerhop 轉機平台　首波串接 Scoot 航網
zh.summary: 台灣虎航與 Dohop 合作推出虛擬聯程服務，讓旅客一次搜尋並預訂跨兩家航空公司的轉機行程。
body: 台灣虎航於 2026 年 10 月 1 日宣布與冰島旅遊科技公司 Dohop 合作，推出 Tigerhop 虛擬聯程平台。首波合作航空公司為 Scoot，旅客可在同一平台組合兩家航空公司的航班。
官方說明列舉的行程包括從新加坡經臺灣轉往日本秋田、鳥取與岡山等地。可選轉機時間為 3 至 48 小時，平台也提供付費的 ConnectSure 轉機保障。
Tigerhop 並非傳統聯程票，兩段航班的行李不會直掛，旅客必須在轉機點領取行李後重新辦理報到。若第一段由台灣虎航執飛且旅客有託運行李，官方表示會提供免費優先行李服務。

en.title: Tigerair Taiwan launches Tigerhop with Scoot as first partner
en.summary: The Dohop-powered virtual interline platform combines separate Tigerair Taiwan and Scoot flights in a single booking flow.
body: Tigerair Taiwan announced on October 1, 2026 that it had launched Tigerhop, a virtual interline platform developed with Icelandic travel-technology company Dohop. Scoot is the first airline partner, allowing travelers to combine flights from the two carriers in one booking flow.

Examples published by the airline include journeys from Singapore through Taiwan to Japanese destinations such as Akita, Tottori and Okayama. The platform permits connection windows of three to 48 hours and offers optional ConnectSure disruption protection.

Tigerhop is not a conventional interline ticket and checked baggage is not transferred automatically. Passengers must collect and re-check bags at the connection point. Tigerair Taiwan says free priority-baggage handling is provided when its flight is the first sector and the traveler has checked baggage.

facts.claim: Tigerair Taiwan launched the Dohop-powered Tigerhop platform on 2026-10-01 with Scoot as the first partner.
Tigerhop offers connection windows from three to 48 hours and optional ConnectSure protection.
Baggage is not through-checked; passengers must collect and re-check it at the connection point.
